caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular framed panel with a central circular motif surrounded by intricate floral decorations in various colors, including shades of pink, white, yellow, orange, red, and green. The top portion features a circular area labeled "Juni" with text inside white backgrounds and black type. Surrounding this are two semicircular bands with German text and rectangular windows showing numbers. At the center of the circular motif is a wheel-like sunburst design with alternating gold and brown spokes and four black number windows. Below, a green trapezoidal area with white text is present, positioned above an illustrated landscape containing a green field, a sun with radiating rays, buildings, winding paths, and scattered trees. Near the bottom, there is a large circle divided into a red rectangle listing the days of the week in German in white text, and a black segment with sequential numbers from 12 to 18. More flowers are depicted in the corners of the frame, and the overall color palette consists of earth tones and muted shades, with detailed decorative patterns filling the available space. The frame itself is green with visible corner joints and wear marks. The name "FRITZ ROEHMER" appears centered at the bottom edge.
title: Zoar Calendar
